caseno: Criminal Petition For Leave To Appeal No. 49 of 1994
lawyer:
Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, Advocate-on-Record ----- For the Petitioner. 
For the Respondents: Not represented.
parties:
Dil Afrose ----- Complaint-Petitioner
Vs.
Md. Mostamsher Billah alias M. S. Billah and others ----- Respondents
full_judgment: 7. Mr. Md. Nawab Ali, learned Advocate-on-Record for the petitioner, submits that the facts of the present case and of that instituted by the complainant's husband are different in that in the earlier case it was alleged that the accused persons attempted to withdraw money from different offices by using the forged share transfer instruments but in the present case the petitioner's allegation is that the accused persons actually withdrew money amounting to Tk. 20,000/- by opening false bank account by using the said share transfer instruments. Mr. Nawab Ali also submits that there being specific allegation of using the forged document in the present case and the opinion of the hand-writing expert being there that there was forgery as alleged the High Court Division was not justified in quashing the present proceeding merely because it was found in the earlier proceeding that the dispute between the parties was of a civil nature.
